_readme: Every ONE-OFF item in the game — today that is the two potions and nothing else. Two sister files generate the rest and both are preferred to authoring by hand here: itemsets.json expands an armour material into one item per plus level, and weapons.json expands a weapon family into one item per tier (a Sturdy sword that rewards Strength and a Nimble one that rewards Dexterity, from the same authored steel). Weapons in particular belong there rather than here, because a weapon authored here carries no scaling grades and is therefore strictly worse than a generated one at the same Attack — see each file's own _readme. NO ROW AUTHORS startingStock; the field still resolves and means what docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md says. The reward roll draws from Equippables rather than from ContentDatabase.Offerable, so a startingStock row would also turn up as a floor-1 reward for gear the player already owns. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. Mixing field sets — a Weapon with an amount, a Consumable with an attackBonus, Equipment using attackBonus instead of statBonus.attack — is rejected rather than silently ignored. A Weapon1 item also fits Weapon2, so dual-wielding needs no second entry. Reward tier comes from the roll, not from this file: RarityTable and LootLadder pick it by encounter class and depth (ItemOfferRoll), so no dropTier field is needed here. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.
